dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Hepatic encephalopathy secondary to undiagnosed chronic liver disease (likely cryptogenic cirrhosis), precipitated by an unidentified acute factor

**Alternatives still considered:**

1. Hepatic encephalopathy secondary to portosystemic shunting (e.g., congenital or acquired shunt) without established cirrhosis

2. Non-cirrhotic hyperammonemia secondary to urea cycle disorder (late-onset)

3. Hepatic encephalopathy secondary to acute liver injury from an undetected hepatotoxin or occult viral hepatitis
